Answers: 1) CAIQ: we'll take your standard CAIQ matrix but please include a short mapping column to our control IDs (we'll share those in the meeting). 2) Logs: 90-day window preferred. 3) Upload: presigned S3 is preferred. We can accept SFTP if you need it, but presigned links are easier for our intake pipeline.

Alice (SecureAudit) — will you confirm if the assessor needs anything else pre-work?

See you Monday.
